summary: P3 (standards; r2 re-check of 1_1, probed against the r1 checker at 52e0967ac): the new heredoc handling hides two unguarded whoami calls the r1 scanner caught. An unquoted heredoc body is skipped whole, but bash runs its `$(npm whoami)` and backticks (`cat <<EOF` / `$(npm whoami)` / `EOF`: r1 [1], now []). An arithmetic shift `X=$(( 1 << 2 ))` is read as a heredoc with delimiter `2` and swallows every later line, so a following `npm whoami` is not counted (r1 [1], now []). Fix: scan `$(`/backticks inside the body when the delimiter is unquoted, and do not start a heredoc inside `$((`/`((`. Blast radius: the shipped pre-flight has no heredoc or arithmetic and passes either way.
